source.author: verg
source.text: Iamque adeo donati omnes opibusque superbi puniceis ibant evincti tempora taenis, cum saevo e scopulo multa vix arte revolsus, amissis remis atque ordine debilis uno, irrisam sine honore ratem Sergestus agebat.
source.text_original: Iamque adeo donati omnes opibusque superbi / puniceis ibant evincti tempora taenis, / cum saevo e scopulo multa vix arte revolsus, / amissis remis atque ordine debilis uno, / irrisam sine honore ratem Sergestus agebat.
source.text_english: And now, all were already going, loaded with spoils and proud in their purple bands tied around their temples, when Sergestus, barely pried away with much skill from a savage rock, with his oars lost and one oar-bench disabled, was driving on his mocked and dishonored vessel.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: cederet his etiam et sese sine honore referret ulterius, sed nube rigens ac nescia rerum stat super et nostros iam zona reverberat ignes.
reuse.text_original: cederet his etiam et sese sine honore referret / ulterius, sed nube rigens ac nescia rerum / stat super et nostros iam zona reverberat ignes.
reuse.text_english: he would even yield to these and withdraw farther, dishonored, but stiffened by a cloud and unaware of events he stands above, and his zone now lashes back our fires.
